'''2007 Corellia Regionals David McCune DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Dave McCune
* '''Deck name:''' Tournament SYC not Fear
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
